insight.debt-collector.why: Printed combat Insight resolved by combat/ext/karma_insights.py.
insight.debt-collector.player_outcome: regain Cultivation Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus when a creature with at least three of your Debt Imprints drops to 0 HP within 60 feet, once per scene

insight.merciless-accountant.why: Printed combat Insight resolved by combat/ext/karma_insights.py.
insight.merciless-accountant.player_outcome: after witnessing a creature carrying your Debt Imprint cause harm again, choose another creature within 60 feet and move one Debt Imprint onto the offender without exceeding your Imprint limit, once until your next turn

insight.borrowed-merit.why: Printed combat Insight resolved by combat/ext/karma_insights.py.
insight.borrowed-merit.player_outcome: another willing creature within 30 feet can donate one of your Grace Imprints to add 1d4 to a failed attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, once per round
